answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each agent in a hardware-attested kernel: a signed enclave key issued once per device, so spawning a thousand fake agents means buying a thousand devices. New agents then join a reef of mutual attestations — established agents vouch only after observing real completed work, and each vouch risks the voucher's own stake. A lone fable of invented reputation cannot bootstrap itself; every fake identity costs real hardware, real time, and real collateral.
